title: Calculator with function values
hints: In `Lookup`, each `case` returns a function *value* plus `nil`: either a named function like `add` (no parentheses: you're not calling it) or a literal `func(a, b int) int { return a * b }`.
The `default` case returns `nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown operator %q", op)`. In `Calc`, call `f, err := Lookup(op)` and `return 0, err` if it failed.
Before `return f(a, b), nil`, guard division: `if (op == "/" || op == "%") && b == 0 { return 0, errors.New("division by zero") }`.
